_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER career ideas from the design mockups - must be replaced or approved by a school counsellor (ASSESSMENT_DESIGN.md 3.6).

R.name: Doer
R.explain: Doers enjoy hands-on work: building, repairing, using tools and machines, and being active, often outdoors. They like seeing a real, finished result.

I.name: Thinker
I.explain: Thinkers enjoy asking questions, testing ideas, solving puzzles and finding out why things happen. They like science, data and discovering new things.

A.name: Creator
A.explain: Creators enjoy imagining, designing, writing, performing and making things look and sound good. They like freedom to try their own ideas.

S.name: Helper
S.explain: Helpers enjoy working with people: teaching, caring, listening and making others feel welcome. They like jobs where they can make a difference to someone.

E.name: Persuader
E.explain: Persuaders enjoy leading teams, convincing people, starting projects and making decisions. They like a bit of challenge and action.

C.name: Organiser
C.explain: Organisers enjoy clear plans, neat records, numbers and making sure everything is in its place. They like knowing things are done properly.
